verdict.rationale: The MI355X is hardware, but its first-party software stack applies to this openness axis: AMD documents ROCm, which includes the compilers, HIP runtime, libraries and tools, as open source, along with open-source collections of ROCm-accelerated libraries. The accelerator itself is not shown as open source, and the docs name no specific license and give no repository location. missing for 10: named open license terms, links to public source repositories, evidence of open firmware/driver/hardware sources, independent corroboration.
